toolstrip.label: Robotics
toolstrip.tooltip: Open the Robotics window: draw a robot and build it into the canvas

files.label: Drawing
files.description: A robot drawing as JSON (format konjugate.robotics.drawing, version 1): written by a script, or kept from another project. Opening one replaces the drawing in the window, and can be undone.

scenarios.name: A heavier solid
scenarios.description: From a time in the run, a solid weighs more: the part in a gripper, say. Watch which motors reach their limit, how hot their windings get and how much charge the cycle takes.
effects: The chosen solid's mass changes to the one given, from the time given to the end of the run.

scenarios.name: A weaker motor
scenarios.description: From a time in the run, a motor gives less torque for its current, as a worn or a smaller one would. Watch whether its joint still keeps up, and what the others do.
effects: The chosen motor's torque constant changes to the one given, from the time given to the end of the run: less torque for its current, and less back-EMF for its speed.

scenarios.name: A tired battery
scenarios.description: From a time in the run, the battery gives fewer volts at every charge, as a tired or a half-flat one does. Watch the motors' top speed and torque fall with it.
effects: The battery's full and empty voltages both fall by the drop given, from the time given to the end of the run.
